description: A Supply Chain Network Flow Chart visualizes the movement of goods, information, and finances across a supply chain. It maps the journey products take from suppliers to consumers, detailing the processes, entities, and resources involved at each step. A well-structured supply chain network ensures that all interconnected entities, such as suppliers, manufacturers, warehouses, and retailers, work seamlessly together to move goods, services, information, and finances from suppliers to end customers. Key Components: Supply Chain Network: Includes suppliers, manufacturers, warehouses, and retailers. Node Structure: Differentiates each node group, such as suppliers, manufacturers, etc. Node Colour: Each node group has a distinct color to represent its role. Links: Edges connecting nodes, representing relationships or flows. Basic Features: Visual Clarity: Ensures clear, easy-to-read visuals for quick data identification. Data Required: Includes key nodes like suppliers, manufacturers, warehouses, and retailers. Nodes: All key nodes (supplier, manufacturer, warehouse, retailer) are visible. Links: All edges connecting different nodes are clearly visible. Performance: Displays node performance at the border of each node group.
